slice.name: hash_chained_idempotent_replay_probe
slice.purpose: Test one zero-cost recurring-Chat durable-adaptation primitive covering update, duplicate resistance, rollback, forgetting guard and exact reconstruction using plain deterministic state plus lightweight repository transport.

mechanism.state_form: canonical JSON base plus append-only event journal
mechanism.idempotency: event_id + exact payload digest; identical replay is no-op, divergent reuse is conflict
mechanism.rollback: append rollback event selecting a previously materialized accepted state; history remains intact
mechanism.reconstruction: replay unique accepted events from base in order

slice.tested_scope: Deterministic small-state event replay only. This establishes the mechanics of durable update/rollback/idempotency/reconstruction for text state; it does not establish semantic model-weight adaptation, concurrent multi-writer correctness, or indefinite repository availability.

zero_dependency_assessment.transport_note: Plain repository contents API is used only as lightweight state transport. The adaptation computation is local deterministic replay, not hosted compute; rate-limit interruption is handled by checkpointing and deferring to a later invocation rather than same-run retry.

slice.conflict_check: No O/downstream/other-worker/legacy semantic input consumed; no protected-primary or scheduler mutation; only own role-local state and sanitized root/config/lifecycle were used.

exact_continuation: Next invocation: extend the same append-only replay protocol with one divergent duplicate event_id payload and a simulated interrupted write boundary; verify conflict rejection plus restart from the last committed digest without applying a partial event. Do not start any unrelated base-work leaf.
